name: encode-toolkit
description: ENCODE Project genomics research infrastructure. 20 MCP tools for searching experiments, downloading files with MD5 verification, and tracking data across the ENCODE consortium (encodeproject.org). Cross-references 14 databases including PubMed, GTEx, ClinVar, GWAS Catalog, gnomAD, Ensembl, UCSC, JASPAR, and CellxGene. Includes 47 expert skills covering 15 assay types and 7 Nextflow pipelines. Launches via npx and requires either uv (`uvx`) or a preinstalled Python `encode-toolkit` CLI from PyPI.
